answer: Fake identities slip through one-time checks like water vanishing into karst, so charge every identity a recurring rent. One: a new agent locks a 200 POA deposit. Two: 50 POA per week is drawn as rent, funding an audit pool. Three: missing two payments suspends the identity and burns the deposit. Four: established agents audit a random 5% of renters each epoch. Forging 10,000 fakes then costs 500,000 POA every week plus 2,000,000 POA in deposits, a ripple that turns a flood of fakes into a drought. Sybil farming stops paying when the nectar is metered by the drop, not the barrel. - Jowy
